headline: ILLIT become one-day traffic police officers for kids
sub: Group teaches traffic and safety rules at a Namyangju school
source: Source: BELIFT LAB via Sports Kyunghyang, Newsen
caption:
ILLIT spent a day as traffic police officers, teaching safety rules to elementary school students.

According to BELIFT LAB, the group joined the Gyeonggi Northern Provincial Police Agency on Nov 17 at an elementary school in Namyangju as a talent donation. Using the whistle from their latest title track as a prop, the members taught traffic rules with rewritten lyrics, ran a child safety lesson and walked students home after class. ILLIT said the experience felt "new and meaningful." A campaign video will be released on the official YouTube channels of ILLIT and the police.
